mechanism: Prednisone may increase ethambutol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and increases tuberculosis infection risk through immunosuppression, while ethambutol efficacy may be reduced by corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for ethambutol toxicity (visual changes, peripheral neuropathy) and ensure adequate TB disease control; use lowest effective prednisone dose and coordinate TB and corticosteroid therapy management.
